title: Newark rent-control annual increase ceiling
requirement: In no case shall the allowable rent increase exceed 4%.
key_value: Maximum 4% for covered Newark rental units; other conditions and approved surcharges require review
coverage_conditions: Only units subject to Newark rent control; registration and substantial-compliance conditions also apply.
exemptions: Not all Newark dwellings are covered. A property-specific rent-control determination is required.
citation: Newark Revised General Ordinances 19:2-3.1; City Division of Rent Control
quoted_span: In no case shall the allowable rent increase exceed 4%.

title: San Diego source-of-income discrimination restriction
requirement: It is unlawful for any person to do any of the following acts, wholly or in part, based on a person’s source of income
coverage_conditions: San Diego rental units, except the owner-occupied shared-kitchen-or-bath circumstance in section 98.0804.
exemptions: Section 98.0804 excludes an owner or family member living in the same building and sharing a kitchen or bathroom with the tenant.
quoted_span: It is unlawful for any person to do any of the following acts, wholly or in part, based on a person’s source of income
